# WebFX: The Digital Marketing Agency That Drives Revenue®

> WebFX is a full-service digital marketing agency that helps businesses grow revenue through SEO, PPC, AI search optimization, web design, and the proprietary RevenueCloudFX platform.

WebFX has driven over $10 billion in client revenue, delivers data-driven strategies across every major digital channel, and publishes in-depth educational content on SEO, PPC, generative AI search, and broader digital marketing topics. This file highlights the most useful pages for LLMs to understand WebFX's services, pricing, technology, and expertise.

## Services

- [Digital Marketing Services](https://www.webfx.com/digital-marketing/services/): Overview of WebFX's full-service digital marketing offerings across SEO, PPC, content, social, email, and more.
- [SEO Services](https://www.webfx.com/seo/services/): Search engine optimization plans, deliverables, and strategy for organic growth.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://www.webfx.com/seo/services/ai-search-optimization/): Services for optimizing visibility in generative AI search engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, and AI Overviews.
- [PPC Services](https://www.webfx.com/ppc/services/): Paid search and paid media management services across Google Ads, Bing, and paid social platforms.

## Pricing

- [Digital Marketing Pricing](https://www.webfx.com/digital-marketing/pricing/): Breakdown of digital marketing pricing across channels, including average monthly costs and factors that influence overall investment.

- [PPC Pricing](https://www.webfx.com/ppc/pricing/): PPC pricing guide covering average costs per click, per impression, and per month across paid advertising campaigns, including a free cost calculator.
- [Generative Engine Optimization Cost](https://www.webfx.com/blog/ai/generative-engine-optimization-cost/): Breakdown of what generative engine optimization typically costs and what factors influence pricing.
